title: Engineering handbook baseline
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing durable repository code MUST apply the engineering baseline this policy references for scope, maintainability, testing, validation reporting, and operator authority.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing code MUST read the complete engineering guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Implementation, review, and QA work MUST apply the referenced rules for bounded scope, maintainability, testing, validation reporting, and operator authority.
Agents MUST interpret core functionality as every new or changed deterministic observable behavior and acceptance criterion, including the primary success path and each material branch.

Agents MUST interpret likely edge cases as reasonably reachable boundary, empty, missing, invalid, and error states implied by the changed input shapes, contracts, nullable values, or prior regressions; exhaustive permutations of equivalent inputs are not required.

Implementation work MUST add unit tests for core functionality and likely edge cases unless the behavior cannot be isolated meaningfully. In that case, the nearest appropriate integration or regression test MUST be added and the substitution MUST be explained.

Automated-test expectations MUST be proportionate to the declared durability of the deliverable. When the active invocation contract designates the work as a throwaway prototype spike, the agent MUST record the deferred coverage and the resulting productionization gap in its output instead of adding production test coverage, and MUST NOT describe the spike as production-ready.

Workflow-local automation under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY be throwaway and need not satisfy the broader readability or abstraction guidance unless it is promoted into durable repository code.
Agents MUST treat the referenced engineering guidance as supporting repository guidance and MUST NOT use it as a replacement for the active invocation contract.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you write, review, or test durable repository code.
